english:
Scoring 3 consecutive kills on <void Weaken />ed enemies within 4 seconds grants <void Devour /> for 5+2.5 seconds.

Hits that would have applied <void Weaken /> also count, even if they instantly kill the enemy.

source.text:
Upon scoring 3 Consecutive Weakened Enemy Kills within 4 seconds of each:

Grants Devour for 5+2.5 seconds.

Hits that would've inflicted Weaken will also count even if they instantly kill an enemy.
